notes:
TIER USED: Tier 1 (direct HTTP curl) hit an immediate PerimeterX-style bot wall ('are-you-human' redirect) on the homepage and on every /browse and /search URL tested. Tier 2 (Playwright/Chromium via npx, custom UA + anti-automation flag) hit the identical bot-check page (headless detection). Per HARD BLOCK RULE moved to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real logged-in browser session) which loaded the site normally - used for all product-page verification. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked first), so Tier 3 use is compliant. Sitemap (sitemap.xml -> sitemap_categories.xml, static XML) WAS reachable via direct curl without a bot wall, and was used to enumerate every candidate category slug/ID site-wide (470KB, ~170 seasonal/holiday-keyword entries) before visiting pages in-browser to verify which were genuine PLPs vs stale/mislabeled/content pages.

DISCOVERY METHOD: Enumerated all sitemap_categories.xml entries containing christmas/halloween/holiday/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/hanukkah/diwali keywords. Two URL patterns exist: /browse/... (real PLP category pages with product grids + site-displayed counts) and /cp/... (marketing/landing content pages, no product grid - excluded per rule). Visited every /browse/ candidate plus the /cp/ hub pages for Halloween, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year and Easter to check whether they merely link out to real /browse/ subcategories. Also checked the top nav 'Departments > Home' flyout (no direct Christmas/Holiday entry) and the top nav 'Halloween' pill (resolves to a /cp/ landing page with no product grid).

CHRISTMAS - confirmed genuine, breadcrumbed 'All Departments/Christmas/Christmas Decor' (or 'Christmas Decor/Wreaths, Garlands & Topiary') with real product grids and site-displayed counts: Christmas Trees (19), Indoor Decor ('Indoor Shop by Look', 80), Outdoor Decor ('Outdoor Shop by Look', 58), Tabletop Decorations (11), Spiritual Decor/Nativity (6), Santas (2), Holiday Lights (19), Ornaments & Tree Trim (8), and a Wreaths/Garlands/Topiary sub-group: Wreaths (21), Garlands (6), Topiary (9). By-height Christmas Tree subcategory URLs (7-7.5ft, 7-9ft, 9-12ft, 3-6ft) are facet filters of the same 19-item Christmas Trees listing, not separate categories - not double-counted. EXCLUDED as not genuinely seasonal despite Christmas-nav placement: 'Candles' (11960104) - generic candle assortment (NEST, diffusers, unscented) with zero Christmas-specific products; 'christmas-storage' (11130118) - sitemap slug now resolves to a generic 'Member's Mark Storage Containers' page under Promotions/Home Promotions, completely unrelated; 'christmas-nutcracker-airblown' (15850103) - dead/stale ID, page returns 'no items found'; Member's Mark brand-hub pages (members-mark-holiday-christmas-trees-ornaments-decor, members-mark-indoor/outdoor-holiday-christmas-decor, members-mark-winter-holiday-christmas-hanukkah-home-decorations) - these are brand-store cross-listings under 'Member's Mark Home' department reusing the same underlying Christmas products already counted above, not a distinct taxonomy branch (dup, not counted separately).

HANUKKAH - searched specifically (sitemap slugs 'christams-spiritual-hanukkah-decor' and 'members-mark-winter-holiday-christmas-hanukkah-home-decorations' both mention Hanukkah). Neither resolves to Hanukkah-specific merchandise: the first is titled 'Religious Christmas Decorations & Spiritual Decor' and contains only nativity/angel Christmas items; the second is the Member's Mark Christmas brand hub. No menorahs, dreidels or other Hanukkah-specific products found anywhere. Concluded Hanukkah is NOT a genuine category on this site - not included as a row.

HALLOWEEN - confirmed genuine, breadcrumbed 'All Departments/Halloween' with real product grids: 'All Halloween Indoor Decor' (24), 'All Halloween Outdoor Decor' (19), and 'Animatronics & Animated Decor' (13, giant witches/skeletons/reapers). The top-nav 'Halloween' pill and 'halloween-decorations' sitemap entry both resolve to /cp/ marketing landing pages (no product grid); style-filtered variants in the related-pages rail (Sam's Exclusive Outdoor Decor, Spooky Indoor/Outdoor, Colorful & Fun, Porch Decor) are facet-filtered subsets of the two Indoor/Outdoor Decor listings already counted, confirmed by overlapping breadcrumbs/products - not double-counted. Halloween costumes/clothing/candy/food/books were out of scope (apparel/food, not home decor) per task instructions.

EASTER - checked both 'Easter' hub (367+, breadcrumb 'Seasonal & Occasions') and 'Easter Decor' (26+): both are storewide gift-catalog pages of ordinary grocery, cookware and dinnerware (KitchenAid cookware sets, mayonnaise, protein shakes, ceramic dinnerware) with zero Easter-themed products (no eggs, bunnies, baskets as decor). This matches the storewide-sale/catalog-page exclusion rule. No genuine Easter home-decor category exists - status NOT included.

VALENTINE'S DAY - /cp/valentine-s-day landing page only links to Dinner, Sweets, Gifts for Her, Kids Valentines, Apparel, Fresh Flowers - no home-decor subcategory exists.

THANKSGIVING - /cp/thanksgiving is 100% a food/catering/entertaining landing page (turkey, sides, appetizer trays, tableware disposables) with zero home-decor products or subcategories.

NEW YEAR - /cp/new-year page returns essentially empty content (no product grid, no subcategory tiles). No genuine New Year decor category exists.

DIWALI - no Diwali-related sitemap entries found at all (searched sitemap_categories.xml directly); confirmed absent.

SCOPE: All rows are Home/Decor/Patio relevant per task instructions; Halloween costumes, candy, food, books, apparel and Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving food & apparel content were excluded as out of scope even where genuine.
